criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First lines name subject, role, and the NSF CEO decision with dollar figures; 'whether AI can find minerals faster than a drill rig' makes the bet concrete. Decision is the hook, not the bio.

criteria.name: Subject + decision load-bearing for AK
criteria.notes: Consequence well-specified (sector, $15M/$160M, NANA/Alaska Silver, 2026-2036), but the AI stake is one facet of a critical-minerals award and the 'binary she owned' is partly desk-constructed from an NSF selection she accepted.

criteria.name: Subject identification fidelity
criteria.notes: Full name + CEO role + professor/UAA Dept affiliation + explicit Anchorage tie (3101 Science Circle). Every fact matches the dossier, including the Anchorage-home/Fairbanks-money axis.

criteria.name: Decision specificity + primary-source
criteria.notes: What+when+binary named, traces to gi.alaska.edu primary and survives multi-source rule via independent NSF.gov; date in window. Binary described concretely (AI exploration+bioextraction vs conventional).

criteria.name: Structural read
criteria.notes: Honest position ('reads the decision as sharp'), praises the competitive NSF win and names capture/opacity risk and the Anchorage-CEO/Fairbanks-money tension proportionately. Matches post_001 energy.

criteria.name: Forward implication
criteria.notes: Names the next decision Munk owns (Year-1 deployment, first go/no-go inside the two-year window) with specific things to watch: subawards, field results, renewal toward $160M.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical, structural, Alaska-first, plainspoken; no banned phrases, no influencer cadence, no hagiography. Reads like the anchor post.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: Tight 2-4 sentence paragraphs, 404 words, under 3000 chars, bio held to ~2 sentences, scans cleanly.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Closes with a genuine debatable binary tied to the specific decision (prove models on public field data first vs. concentrate the bet). No CTA, no softener.

criteria.name: Credibility guard
criteria.notes: Decision treatment outweighs bio, every claim traceable to corroborated sources, praise and critique both earned. Not recycled or invented.

hard_fails.name: punctuation_bans_held
hard_fails.note: No em/en-dashes, double-hyphens, colons, or semicolons in body.

hard_fails.name: subject_named_and_anchorage_tied
hard_fails.note: Full name + role + UAA affiliation and explicit Anchorage tie.

hard_fails.name: recent_decision_named_with_primary_source
hard_fails.note: 2026-07-14 decision, gi.alaska.edu primary cited, within window.

hard_fails.name: grounded_not_press_release
hard_fails.note: Real analytical position with proportionate critique, no hagiographic verbs.

hard_fails.name: no_invented_quotes
hard_fails.note: Single quote verbatim from dossier subject_quotes[0].
